beats.care: India's unbeaten run in home T20 series survives, but only just. Bumrah and Akash Deep are back for the New Zealand Tests next month.
beats.what: Rain cut Saturday's decider to nine overs a side. India made 118 for 5 in 7.4 overs before rain returned for good.
beats.why: West Indies never got to bat, so the five-match series ended level, with two wins each.

cards.body: India won in Lucknow and Indore. West Indies won in Ranchi and at Uppal, where Shai Hope's unbeaten 102 off 50 balls set up a 24-run win.
Shubman Gill captains, KL Rahul is vice-captain. Akash Deep returns after a back stress fracture, Anshul Kamboj is recalled, and Bumrah plays only the Tests to manage his workload.
cards.title: who's in the new zealand test squad?

cards.body: West Indies chose to bowl first, and then never had to bat at all.

cards.q: Will India win the first Test in Wellington?

opts: The deciding match was washed out
It was a tie on runs
cards.why: With two wins each, the abandoned fifth game left the series level.

hook: India were *118/5 in 7.4 overs*. Then the rain came back

learn.t: When a decider is washed out, nobody wins: the series is shared, and both captains lift the trophy together.

watch: India's New Zealand tour starts with ODIs on 4 Nov. First Test in Wellington from 19 Nov, 3:30 am IST.
